title: Pakistan Launches 'Operation Shaban' Counterterrorism Campaign in Balochistan
detail: Pakistan launched Operation Shaban, a joint Army/Frontier Corps/Balochistan Police/intelligence counterterrorism campaign across multiple Balochistan districts, in response to a wave of early-July attacks attributed to both TTP and Baloch separatist militants, including the July 4 Hanna Urak attack in Quetta.

sources.name: The Diplomat — Pakistan's Operation Shaban Targets Both the TTP and BLA in Balochistan

media.caption: Pakistan launched Operation Shaban, a counterterrorism campaign across Balochistan targeting TTP and Baloch separatist militants.
